subject: problem in stat_quantile: extra lines appearing when conditioning on  a variable

messages.author: 79cbcdf70bb4b9c6
messages.subject: problem in stat_quantile: extra lines appearing when conditioning on  a variable
parts:
Hi all,

I came across what seems like a bug in stat_quantile: when using
grouping, extra lines appear connecting the continuous quantiles. It
is easier to illustrate the problem than to explain it:
x <- seq(0,1,l=100)
y1 <- 5*x + runif(100)
y2 <- 3*x + runif(100)
df <- data.frame(x=x,y=c(y1,y2),condition=gl(2,100))
ggplot(df,aes(x=x,y=y,colour=condition)) + stat_quantile()

Does anyone know how to fix that?

Thanks,

Simon Barthelmé

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: problem in stat_quantile: extra lines appearing when conditioning  on a variable
parts:
Hi Simon,

This will be fixed in the next version of ggplot2. You can work
around it my explicitly specifying the grouping:

ggplot(df,aes(x=x,y=y,colour=condition)) +
stat_quantile(aes(group = interaction(group, ..quantile..)))

Hadley

Hi Hadley,

Yep, that did it. I did not have "quantreg" installed, once I

Wow, I cannot believe how quickly you respond. Thanks so much!

On somewhat of a tangent (it's 'R' related, but not ggplot2): is
there any easy way to discover what I was missing on my own? E.g., is

that package "blah" is required. Normally I can just type
"stat_quantile" without the brackets and I get the code, but it is
hidden when I try this. (I just get the info below.)
